texto.en: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
texto.es: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

texto.en: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made;
texto.es: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made;

texto.en: and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
texto.es: and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

texto.en: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it:
texto.es: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it:

texto.en: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
texto.es: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

texto.en: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created,

texto.en: in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

texto.en: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew:
texto.es: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew:

texto.en: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.

texto.en: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

texto.en: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life;
texto.es: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life;

texto.en: and man became a living soul.
texto.es: and man became a living soul.

texto.en: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
texto.es: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

texto.en: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food;
texto.es: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food;

texto.en: the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
texto.es: the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

texto.en: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
texto.es: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

texto.en: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
texto.es: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

texto.en: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

texto.en: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
texto.es: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

texto.en: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria.
texto.es: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria.

texto.es: And the fourth river is Euphrates.

texto.en: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
texto.es: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

texto.en: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
texto.es: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

texto.en: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it:
texto.es: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it:

texto.en: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
texto.es: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

texto.en: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
texto.es: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

texto.en: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air;
texto.es: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air;

texto.en: and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature,
texto.es: and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature,

texto.en: that was the name thereof.
texto.es: that was the name thereof.

texto.en: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field;
texto.es: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field;

texto.en: but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
texto.es: but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

texto.en: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam and he slept: and he took one of his ribs,
texto.es: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam and he slept: and he took one of his ribs,

texto.en: and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman,
texto.es: and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman,

texto.en: and brought her unto the man.
texto.es: and brought her unto the man.

texto.en: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman,
texto.es: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman,

texto.en: because she was taken out of Man.
texto.es: because she was taken out of Man.

texto.en: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife:
texto.es: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife:

texto.en: and they shall be one flesh.
texto.es: and they shall be one flesh.

texto.en: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
texto.es: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

texto.en: So what does this chapter mean? Here are four simple ideas.
texto.es: ¿Y qué quiere decir este capítulo? Acá van cuatro ideas simples.

texto.en: First: rest is part of the plan. The week is not finished until a day of rest is blessed.
texto.es: Primera: el descanso es parte del plan. La semana no termina hasta que se bendice un día de descanso.

texto.en: Second: life is a gift. The first man gets breath, a garden, and work to do.
texto.es: Segunda: la vida es un regalo. El primer hombre recibe aliento, un jardín y un trabajo.

texto.en: Third: one rule is given. It is a simple limit, set inside a world of plenty.
texto.es: Tercera: se da una sola regla. Es un límite simple, dentro de un mundo de abundancia.

texto.en: Fourth: people need each other. The first thing called not good is being alone.
texto.es: Cuarta: las personas se necesitan. Lo primero que no es bueno es estar solo.

texto.en: The man names the animals, but none of them is the partner he needs.
texto.es: El hombre les pone nombre a los animales, pero ninguno es la compañía que necesita.

texto.en: The text says the two become one flesh. That describes a deep bond between them.
texto.es: El texto dice que los dos se hacen una sola carne. Eso describe un vínculo profundo entre ellos.

texto.en: Different readers understand some details in different ways. The core message is care, rest, and belonging.
texto.es: Distintos lectores entienden algunos detalles de maneras distintas. El mensaje central es cuidado, descanso y pertenencia.

texto.en: One more thing: in the original Hebrew, a few words say even more.
texto.es: Una cosa más: en el hebreo original, algunas palabras dicen todavía más.

texto.en: The Hebrew word for man is adam. The word for ground is adamah. So the name sounds like "earthling".
texto.es: La palabra hebrea para hombre es adam. La palabra para tierra es adamah. El nombre suena como "terrícola".

texto.en: From verse four, the text says LORD God in capital letters. That stands for God's personal name, the four letters YHWH.
texto.es: Desde el versículo cuatro, el texto dice LORD God en mayúsculas. Eso representa el nombre personal de Dios, las cuatro letras YHWH.

texto.en: And "living soul" is the Hebrew nephesh chayah, which simply means a living being.
texto.es: Y "alma viviente" es el hebreo nefesh jayá, que simplemente significa un ser vivo.

texto.en: The garden has a man, a woman, and one rule. What happens to that rule opens the next chapter.
texto.es: El jardín tiene un hombre, una mujer y una regla. Lo que pasa con esa regla abre el próximo capítulo.

texto.en: Next time: Genesis, Chapter 3. The serpent and the fruit.
texto.es: La próxima vez: Génesis, capítulo 3. La serpiente y el fruto.

texto.en: Thank you for reading the Bible with me, one chapter at a time.
texto.es: Gracias por leer la Biblia conmigo, un capítulo a la vez.
